metadata.case_name: LEE PO FOON v. AU CHI KIN

plaintiff.occupation_before: clerk at the dental clinic of North District Hospital (civil servant)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: clerk at the dental clinic of North District Hospital

source: The doctor recorded a diagnosis of minor head injury, she was given symptomatic treatment and the prognosis was ‘good with minimal permanent disability’.
The record of finding on admission revealed she suffered from right forehead haematoma.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

source: she was found to have retrograde amnesia on arrival to the Accident and Emergency Department.
post concussional disorder with impairment in cognitive functioning accompanied by specific neuro behavioural symptoms that occurred as a consequence of closed head injury concussion.

injuries.description: minor neck sprain with soft tissue injury
source: had a neck injury at the accident which should be a minor neck sprain with soft tissue injury which had recovered at the time of examination;
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain, stiffness or tenderness only

injuries.description: scapular pain due to a sprain or contusion of the region
source: scapular pain due to a sprain or contusion of the region during the accident. No sign of shoulder joint involvement found.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of other or unspecified parts of shoulder girdle

injuries.description: contusion in the right shoulder and thigh
source: Madam Lee complained that she had suffered contusion in the right shoulder and thigh and whiplash in the cervical spine at the accident.

injuries.description: post-traumatic temporomandibular disorders (TMD); TMJ derangement with anterior disc displacement on the right side
source: Dr. Chow diagnosed she was suffering from post-traumatic temporomandibular disorders (TMD).
TMJ derangement with anterior disc displacement on the right side. Diagnostic arthroscopy was suggested ….… preferred to continue with the conservative treatment.
injuries.icd_description: Dislocation or sprain of other specified joints or ligaments of head

manifestations.description: anxiety when traveling in motor vehicles
TMJ clicking and recurrent facial pain

treatments_received: admitted to the Prince of Wales Hospital neurological ward
physiotherapy (29 sessions recorded orthopaedically; additional physiotherapy at Union Hospital and hydrotherapy)
botox injection to the right and left masseter muscles
treatments_future: monthly psychological treatment for 12 months (recommended by Dr. Chung)

losses.description: she developed poor marital relationship with her husband.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: had to hire a helper on Sundays, the day her domestic helper was on leave.

pain and suffering caused by the traffic accident and the post-concussional disorder which had triggered a relapse of the dysthymic disorder indicated her suffering and loss of amenities to be of a more serious nature.
depression / relapse of dysthymic disorder anxiety when traveling in motor vehicles

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Ka Ming v. Lee Wai Kong
comparable_cases.injury_description: tenderness over right knee, neck and cervical spine; persistent pain on neck and lower back and weakness of the right limb; 14 months sick leave.

comparable_cases.case_name: Yau Kwok Yue v. Dong Shu Kei Beau
comparable_cases.injury_description: 35 year old plaintiff sustained injuries to his head and back; 19 months after attack still suffering from depressed mood, poor sleep, lacking in concentration and interests; diagnosed with post-traumatic disorder, post concussional syndrome and depressive disorder.

comparable_cases.injury_description: 35 year old plaintiff received a severe 'whiplash' injury to her neck and back; psychiatrist diagnosed post-traumatic disorder, post-concussional syndrome and depressive disorder.
